engine_basis: Zend/zend_object_handlers.c::zend_std_compare_objects compares distinct same-class builtin objects through initialized physical slots.

Both trace graphs are allocated and canonical; at least one captured frame args array contains a DIRECT PARRAY. Every child array is allocated, finite and acyclic along its path, with DIRECT array or null/bool/int/float/plain-string/valid-string-carrier leaves. All seven operators and direct/equal-prefix aggregate comparison use ordinary physical slot and nested array count/key/value order; callbacks, references, objects and recursive array paths are excluded.
